plugin.name: Chronicle Panel Examples
plugin.description: Reference library containing multiple trusted Chronicle custom panels.

panels.name: Example: Damage Summary
panels.description: Summarizes player and pet damage with floating per-player source and ability breakouts.

panels.name: Example: Gear Rarity
panels.description: Breaks down each player's equipped items by rarity with sortable columns.

panels.name: Example: Replay Casts
panels.description: Lists casts up to Chronicle's current replay timestamp.

panels.name: Example: First Casts
panels.description: Shows each player's first damage or heal event in every selected encounter, ordered by encounter offset.

panels.name: Cast Timeline
panels.description: Plots each player's successful casts as a zoomable swimlane timeline so repeating rotations stand out.
